[[Fester Fang]] is a [[Devourer]] [[boss]] that can be found in several places in [[Ascalon]].

== Locations ==
* [[Ascalon]]
** {{NPC location|Eastern Frontier}}
** {{NPC location|Pockmark Flats}}

== Missions ==
* Ascalon
** {{NPC location|Ruins of Surmia}}

== Skills ==
0 [[Blood Magic]], 5 [[Curses]] (20 Blood Magic, 18 Curses in [[hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Life Siphon}}
* {{skill icon|Parasitic Bond}}
* {{skill icon|Putrid Explosion}}
* {{skill icon|Weaken Armor}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Chitin Fragment]]
* [[Fetid Carapace]]
* [[Half-Eaten Mass]]

== Notes ==
* In [[Ruins of Surmia]], this boss shares three [[spawn]] locations with two other Devourer bosses ([[Gnash Underfoot]] and [[Hurl Foulspine]]); however, one of the three will spawn in an sealed off area near the location of [[Breena Stavinson]] (point 2 on the wiki map) that cannot be reached by the [[party]].

== Trivia ==
* [http://translate.google.com/#de|en|Fester%20Fang Fester Fang] means "solid catch" in German.
